notes: ἔμπροσθεν is an improper preposition, so rule 71 settles its complex frame's head on the lexical noun 'sight' rather than on 'in'; the frame is discontinuous around 'thy' under rule 15.
The article before the vocative πατήρ is unrepresented under rule 89, the ASV writing a bare 'Father' and supplying no address word.
